definitions.explanation: Used by an author or publisher to refer to the book in hand, mostly in prefaces, introductions and blurbs. In contracts and official papers it means "this document".

examples.japanese: {本書|ほんしょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三部|さんぶ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{成|な}る。
examples.english: This book consists of three parts.

examples.japanese: {本書|ほんしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

{本書|ほんしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}する→紹介する：05641_shoukaisuru⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{初心者|しょしんしゃ}→初心者：10149_shoshinsha⟧で⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{試|ため}せる→試す：02130_tamesu⟧もの⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧だ。
examples.english: The methods introduced in this book can all be tried at once, even by beginners.

notes:
USAGE:
Formal and written. In conversation, say ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{本|ほん}. A reader writing about someone else's book also uses {本書|ほんしょ} in a review, to mean "the book under review".

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {本書|ほんしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧: the aim of this book
- {本書|ほんしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧: in this book
- {本書|ほんしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧: the contents of this book

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {本|ほん}: book; the everyday word
- {本稿|ほんこう}: this paper or article (academic)
